PRODUCT

YAW DISC
REFURBISHMENT SERVICE
REMOVES WEAR & TEAR
DISC RESURFACING TOOL GEN2


DESCRIPTION
Svendborg Brakes offers a specialized disc resurfacing ser vice designed
to restore yaw discs to optimal condition after years of wear and tear. The
on-site refurbishment ser vice solution minimizes turbine downtime and
reduces maintenance expenses compared to replacing the worn disc. This
ser vice utilizes the Disc Resurfacing Tool Gen2. It is developed in-house
by Svendborg Brakes engineers and enables a quick and professional
refurbishment delivered by trained field ser vice engineers.
KEY SERVICE FEATURES
•                                          On-site and uptower refurbishment of upper and lowe disc/ring
•                                          Fast turbine setup and execution, ensuring minimal disruption to turbine
     operations
•                                          Extensive experience and compact tool enables wide range of
     refurbishable turbines

  SPECIFICATIONS
  Fits 90 & 120 style yaw brak es and sliding systems

 Max power consumption                                             4   Kw

 Feed rate max.                                                                                                                                                                                     15 mm per per second (normal yaw speed)

 Crane capacit y to lift
 Disc        Resurfacing Tool                                                                                                   50 kg
